description: This file defines a DeviceDetectionService class for detecting device characteristics (e.g., tablet, phone, iOS, Android, iPhone X) in a React Native app, including methods for setting device size, orientation, and device type flags.

classes.name: DeviceDetectionService
classes.description: A class providing device detection utilities for React Native applications.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the service and sets default device values.

methods.name: isTablet
methods.description: Returns whether the device is a tablet.

methods.name: setNewValues
methods.description: Updates device size and type flags based on current dimensions.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets device size and orientation, updating internal flags.

methods.name: getDeviceSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns device size relative to width.

methods.name: getScreenSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns screen size relative to width.

methods.name: checkSmallTab
methods.description: Determines if the device is a small tablet or phone based on size and orientation.

methods.name: isPhoneOrTablet
methods.description: Sets flags for phone or tablet detection.

methods.name: isIosOrAndroid
methods.description: Sets flags for iOS or Android platform.

methods.name: detectIphoneX
methods.description: Detects if the device is an iPhone X based on dimensions.

methods.name: isLargeTablet
methods.description: Returns true if device is a large tablet.
